title: The Influence of Melatonin Supplementation in the Group of Persons Performing Competitive Sport.
brief_summary: The research aims to determine the impact of 30-day supplementation of melatonin on the antioxidative defense mechanisms and the release of markers of oxidative stress and inflammation in rowers and footballers undergoing training of submaximal intensity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* sign informed consent form for participation in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* diseases
* the participants will not be minor and incapacitated persons, soldiers, prisoners and persons dependent in any way from the investigators
